basic-functions/adding-bookmarks.title: Adding bookmarks
basic-functions/adding-bookmarks.description: To add a bookmark via the Address Bar:

basic-functions/browsing-history.title: Browsing history
basic-functions/browsing-history.description: 1. Tap the bookmark icon at the bottom to view your browsing history.

basic-functions/highlighted-search-and-t.title: Highlighted Search and translate
basic-functions/highlighted-search-and-t.description: 1. Hold down on a string inside a page to select it

basic-functions/opening-bookmarks.title: Opening bookmarks
basic-functions/opening-bookmarks.description: 1. Tap the "Bookmarks" button (the book-shaped icon) at the bottom of the screen

basic-functions/opening-urls.title: Opening URLs
basic-functions/opening-urls.description: 1. In the Address Bar that appears, tap the address area

basic-functions/printing_1.title: Printing
basic-functions/printing_1.description: 1. Tap the "Menu" button at the bottom of the screen

basic-functions/saving-images.title: Saving images
basic-functions/saving-images.description: 1. Hold down on the image you wish to save

basic-functions/web-search.title: Web search
basic-functions/web-search.description: 1. Tap the search bar on the top or search icon on the bottom.

faq/about-known-issues.title: About known issues
faq/about-known-issues.description: You can access our list of known issues at the User Forum. If you search for appropriate keywords in the forum, you might find that your problem is already registered.

faq/about-url-schema-of-lunascape.title: About URL schema of Lunascape
faq/about-url-schema-of-lunascape.description: The URL scheme of Lunascape mobile supports Lunascape and iLunascape.

index.title: Introduction
index.description: Welcome to the Lunascape Mobile Browser user guide. This guide is designed to comprehensively support you from basic operations to advanced features when using the Lunascape browser on mobile devices.

useful-functions/saving-images-in-the-ph.description: Images can be saved to the standard Photo Album of iOS. If this feature is disabled, images will be saved to Photo in your smartphone.
